Real gap, but the fix is a product decision, not a bug fix: Sentry event context shows the app started 2026-11-13T02:12Z with about 3 days of identity left, so AuthenticationScreenController.OnBeforeViewShow's existing "force re-login if <24h left" guard (#1667) correctly let it through; the 30-day identity then expired in-world after about 51h of uptime (05:06Z), and from then on every signed request (Events, Places, social RPC, comms) fails, because nothing re-checks expiry at runtime: ProxyIdentityCache only discards expired identities on the storage path, and the memory copy is returned as-is. Filtering at the Sentry gateway would hide a client stuck in a broken state it could recover from, so this is not noise. Come back later.") and the fishing-styled dialog exist nowhere in the client (no match in any .cs/.prefab/.asset/.json), so it is UI rendered by the Genesis Plaza scene itself; the issue still has no repro and the attached log has no entry tied to it, so this belongs to the scene/content owners (likely Halloween fishing leftover), not a client fix.

Re-verified on origin/dev 04c7a938b: the UUAV Rust source is in-repo (Explorer/Assets/Plugins/UUAV/native), and select_streams in native/src/playback/unit.rs:90 takes find_best_stream(VIDEO) without excluding AV_DISPOSITION_ATTACHED_PIC, so an mp3's mjpeg cover art becomes the video track and the hardware-only macOS decoder rejects it; but there is no C# workaround (uuav_player_open_media_async takes only a URL, no audio-only/disable-video option exists in NativeMethods.cs or the IPC protocol), and any native edit changes the source digest that uuav-verify.yml checks against scripts/uuav/uuav-binaries.lock.json, so the fix needs a uuav-native.yml rebuild of both platforms plus a human relock, which a sweep commit cannot produce.

Re-verified on origin/dev 04c7a938b: the GPU skinning path maps joints by list position, not by name (AttachmentAssetUtility.BuildSpringBoneData treats skin joints 0..61 as the avatar skeleton and only 62+ as spring bones; ComputeSkinningBufferContainer.CopyAllBuffers offsets only indices >= BASE_BONE_COUNT), so a GLB whose exporter lists the spring chain in hierarchy order (right after Avatar_Head / Avatar_LeftHand) would get its links mapped onto base bones like the neck/shoulder, which matches the report; but the GLBs are still only in Slack, so the joint order cannot be confirmed, and the real fix (remapping weights and bind poses by name for every mesh) is a broad GPU skinning change that needs those files and an on-device check.

Re-verified on origin/dev 04c7a938b and js-sdk-toolchain: PulseRealm.EnsureResolvedAsync derives the local Pulse realm ("lsd:" + entity id) from the scene entity the preview returns for the parcel, and the preview's POST /content/entities/active (sdk-commands start/server/endpoints.ts) returns [] for a smart-wearable project; the realm key is a shared contract that sdk-commands and every other Explorer must derive identically, so a client-only fallback key would not match the preview's room. The fix belongs in js-sdk-toolchain (serve a scene-like entity, or define the wearable key in the contract), with any Explorer change following it.
